name: Veiled Inheritance
source:
A sudden inheritance. A house full of secrets.
When your uncle Richard dies under mysterious circumstances, his sprawling estate isn't the only thing left in your care. Along with the house come three unexpected residents: his live-in nurse, Diana, and her two daughters, Mia and Ava.
From day one, nothing feels right. What starts as a simple trip to settle his affairs quickly spirals into a web of hidden agendas, forbidden lust, and dangerous curiosity.
The doors are open.
The women are waiting.And the truth about your uncle is only the beginning.​

[From F95]
translation:
一笔突如其来的遗产，一座藏满秘密的宅邸。
当你的舅舅理查德离奇身亡后，留给你接管的远不止他那座占地广阔的庄园——随老宅一同留下的还有三位意想不到的住客：他的住家护士黛安娜，以及她的两个女儿米娅与艾娃。
从踏入庄园的第一天起，一切都透着说不出的蹊跷。原本只是前来料理后事的寻常之行，很快便卷入了一张由暗藏的企图、禁忌的情欲与危险的好奇心交织而成的罗网。
房门已经敞开。
女人们正在等待。而关于你舅舅的真相，才仅仅是个开始。

[摘自F95]
